The native port stores the same raw values, so no unit-conversion boundary was introduced (nothing to convert).

Native-safe browser-only remaps (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) DOM <input type='time'> picker -> controlled RN <TextInput> 'HH:MM' text entry with the unchanged split(':') parse; (b) DOM <input type='number' min max> spinners -> numeric keyboards (number-pad/numeric) with the unchanged parseInt/parseFloat coercion (no native min/max enforcement, identical to the web fallback `|| 1` / `|| 0`); (c) @/components/ui HelpIcon hover tooltip -> an inline muted helper caption rendering t(i18nKey, content) so the help copy is reachable on touch devices; (d) lucide SVG icons -> SemanticIconName metadata strings (not rendered here).
